parameters.content:
## AI SEO Opportunity Engine

Automatically scans Google Search Console (GSC) and Google Analytics 4 (GA4) every morning, detects ranked SEO opportunities across 6 signal types, then delivers an AI-generated action plan to Slack, Notion, and email.

### What this workflow does
Pulls 28-day current and previous-period data from GSC and GA4, detects Quick Wins, CTR Gaps, Content Decay, Cannibalization, New Queries, and Conversion Opportunities, scores each signal P1–P3, appends raw results to Google Sheets, and delivers an AI-written action plan to 3 output channels.

### How it works
1. Schedule triggers at 7 am daily and calculates two 28-day date windows
2. GSC API fetches query + page data for both periods
3. GA4 fetches sessions and engagement metrics for both periods
4. Detect Opportunities code identifies and ranks up to 30 scored signals
5. Raw backlog appended to Google Sheets for historical tracking
6. GPT-4o writes an Executive Summary, Top 5 Actions, and 30-Day Roadmap
7. Report delivered to Notion, Slack, and email simultaneously

### Setup
- [ ] Google OAuth2 credential connected (for GSC API calls)
- [ ] Set your full GSC site URL in both GSC nodes
- [ ] Google Analytics credential + GA4 Property selected
- [ ] Google Sheets credential + spreadsheet selected
- [ ] OpenAI credential (or n8n credits) on AI SEO Analyst
- [ ] Notion credential + SEO Backlog database selected
- [ ] Slack credential + target channel name set
- [ ] Gmail credential + recipient email set

### Customization
Adjust signal thresholds (impressions, CTR%, decay %, session count) in Detect Opportunities. Change trigger hour in Schedule. Edit AI report sections in Format AI Prompt. Add or remove output channels to match your team's delivery preferences.

## DATA COLLECTION
Fetches current and previous 28-day data from Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4.

## OPPORTUNITY DETECTION
Analyzes GSC + GA4 data to identify and score up to 30 ranked SEO opportunities across 6 signal types.

## AI ANALYSIS
Formats ranked opportunities into a structured prompt, then GPT-4o produces an Executive Summary, Top 5 Actions, and 30-Day Roadmap.

## OUTPUT & REPORTING
Appends raw opportunities to Google Sheets, then delivers the AI action plan to Notion (backlog), Slack (summary), and email (HTML report).

## ⚠️ GSC Setup Required

Both GSC nodes need your full Search Console API URL with your URL-encoded site property:

`https://searchconsole.googleapis.com/webmasters/v3/sites/sc-domain%3Ayourdomain.com/searchAnalytics/query`

Replace `sc-domain%3Ayourdomain.com` with your verified GSC property. Make sure your Google OAuth2 credential has the Search Console API scope enabled.
